narration.text: Every uninsured and self-pay patient's good faith estimate sent on time, and every bill 400 dollars over its estimate caught before it goes out. This is a chore for the billing lead of a two-physician family practice that sees uninsured and self-pay patients every week. Athena works it across 3 portals: Chartmend PM, Chartleaf scheduling and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 400 dollars of the 400 dollars there was to find. All 8 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. Among them: A new estimate at the billed amount, after the visit, so the bill matches it. An estimate for a visit the patient cancelled. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 75 minutes, so she was about 26 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
